finding: The Mac MLX path (AirLLMLlamaMlx) cannot stream Qwen3 weights: Qwen3 uses QK-norm (q_norm/k_norm per-head norms), and the MLX TransformerBlock has no such parameters -> ValueError: Module does not have parameter named "q_norm". implication: Qwen3-4B/8B are NOT Mac AirLLM targets (unlike the plan's §9.1/§9.2 optional-evaluation hypothesis). Valid Mac targets must be Llama-family without QK-norm, e.g. TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 (2.2 GB).
